description: Fix 3 and the prompt side of fix 4 (+ fix 8b, repeat-count lint): a gap guard that records rules existing only as verbatim prose (where a structural field exists) as compile gaps and marks the build degraded in compile_report and the trace; a derived closing.aggregation.default; weekday names from the spec calendar, holidays with weekday names, per-weekday hours and a 'use only listed dates' rule injected into the prompts; an explicit per-product loop for multi-product notes; lint for contradictory repeat counts. Depends on FEAT-001 (new schema fields) and FEAT-002 (hook variables). Independent of FEAT-004's graph changes, but both edit compiler.py/node_prompts.py/test_compiler.py, so they run sequentially.
steps: 3.1 Create builder/gap_guard.py per plan section 5 'Fix 3' (KINDS table deadline_formula/amount_floor/callback_window/persuasion_date; satisfied() predicates on the structural fields; kind_cues/detail_cues/ADMISSION_CUES; find_unstructured(spec_dict) -> list of Gap(kind, evidence, source); floor universe = debt_statement.product_names types + floor_fields keys + floor_percent keys; verbatim_rules[].gap_kind is the precise signal, warnings/verbatim cues are the safety net; one gap per kind; imports only `re`).

3.1b builder/compiler.py: CompileReport.degraded (list) and a 'degraded' key in to_dict(); _Build.apply_gap_guard() called before finish() adds self.gap('unstructured rule (<kind>): ...') and report.degraded entries; fallback_post order = closing.aggregation.default -> derived default (new _derive_aggregation_default(): persuasion.on_exhausted, else promise_rules.on_failure.outcome, else the unique non-aggregated outcome_table row used by first_note_not_equal with a reason in multi_product.notes.reasons; derive precedence ['transfer','any_promise'] + configured note steps when the spec has none) -> gap 'no safe default derivable'; warn 'derived' instead of the old 'missing' warning; final_cfg()['aggregation'] embeds the derived default so close pre-hook and finalize agree. Update the three exact-key-set assertions (tests/test_compiler.py:184, tests/test_compiler_fallback.py:29, tests/test_selfcheck.py:245) to include 'degraded'.

3.1c builder/pipeline.py: in stage_compile_workflow and _try_repair (which rewrites compile_report.json) call _degrade(ctx, 'compile: ...') for every report.degraded and keep 'degraded' in compile_report.json; exit code stays 0. Copy runs/rehearsal-20261011-132458/spec.json byte-for-byte to tests/fixtures/spec_rehearsal.json (never edit it; use `cp`). Tests: new tests/test_gap_guard.py (positive/negative per kind; clean on spec_brief_a/ab; MUST report amount_floor for spec_variant_1..3; spec_rehearsal yields exactly deadline_formula, amount_floor, callback_window, persuasion_date and compiles with report.degraded non-empty); aggregation default tests (derived, table-derived, impossible -> gap, explicit default wins, close pre-hook outcome for verified+nothing recorded equals the derived default); tests/test_pipeline_compile.py (DEGRADED: compile: line in trace.log and degraded list in compile_report.json for a dry build of the rehearsal fixture via --spec / run_build).

3.2 builder/node_prompts.py: _date_lines business-week sentence from spec.calendar ('Business days are <names>; <weekend names> are never business days', names ordered from week_starts_on, never a Monday-Friday assumption) + rule 'use only dates that appear in the date facts and product facts; never work out a weekday yourself'; _third_party_lines adds the business-week sentence, holidays WITH weekday names computed from the spec's ISO dates with datetime (never typed), and per-weekday hours in words; DATE_RULE_TEXT entry for business_days_after_today using date_n; _multi_lines per-product loop (fix 8b) for multi_product.enabled with notes (numbered steps: state, read back + promise tool, otherwise note with a reason from the list, a claim on one product never ends the call, end only when every product has a promise or a note, several products named in one message are handled one at a time). Tests in tests/test_node_prompts.py (Sunday-Thursday and Monday-Friday specs, holiday weekday names, per-weekday hours, loop present for multi-product and absent for single product).

3.3 builder/lint.py: rule_repeat_counts (warn) per plan section 5 fix 6 'lint' paragraph (sentence split, counts once/twice/thrice/<n> times, topic words = alphabetic tokens of length >= 3 minus stopwords/count words, >= 2 shared topic words and different counts -> warning); register it in lint(); tests in tests/test_lint.py with synthetic task texts (conflict, no conflict, same count).
acceptance_criteria: Compiling spec_rehearsal.json (a real extraction) succeeds, reports the four unstructured-rule gaps in report.gaps and report.degraded, and a dry pipeline run writes a DEGRADED: compile: line to trace.log and the degraded list to compile_report.json with exit code 0.
Compiling spec_brief_a/ab reports no unstructured-rule gap; spec_variant_1..3 report the amount_floor gap (percent floors are prose only in those extractions).
closing.aggregation.default missing -> a derived default (warning 'derived') or an explicit gap; never only a warning that ships a silent fallback.
Prompts for a Sunday-Thursday calendar name Sunday as a business day and list the weekend from the spec; no Monday-Friday assumption anywhere in builder text.
uv run pytest -q passes (>= 679, 0 failures); contamination script clean.
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_gap_guard.py tests/test_compiler.py tests/test_compiler_fallback.py tests/test_pipeline_compile.py tests/test_node_prompts.py tests/test_lint.py tests/test_selfcheck.py

uv run python build.py briefs/brief-a.md --dry --spec tests/fixtures/spec_rehearsal.json --slot offline-rehearsal  # read trace.log for 'DEGRADED: compile:', then delete only that runs/offline-rehearsal-* dir
findings: FEAT-003 done, nothing committed. pytest 819 passed (was 800); contamination 0 hits; dry build of spec_rehearsal exits 0 with 4 'DEGRADED: compile:' trace lines and 'degraded' in compile_report.json (offline-rehearsal run dir deleted). Light testing per user. gap_guard API (builder/gap_guard.py, imports only re): find_unstructured(spec_dict) -> list[Gap] (plain class: kind, evidence<=200 chars, source in 'verbatim_rules.gap_kind'|'warnings'|'verbatim_rules'); KINDS (deadline_formula, amount_floor, callback_window, persuasion_date) = (used-predicate, kind cues, detail test); satisfied(kind, spec); floor_covered(spec) (empty product universe = not covered); product_universe(spec); ADMISSION_CUES. Warnings are matched as whole strings (admission + kind + detail cue). Results: spec_brief_a/ab none; variants 1..3 amount_floor; spec_rehearsal exactly the 4 kinds. Report fields: CompileReport.degraded (list[str]) and 'degraded' key in to_dict() (3 key-set tests updated); gaps AND degraded get 'unstructured rule (<kind>): <evidence>'. compiler: _Build.apply_gap_guard() runs before finish(); fallback_post = aggregation.default -> _derive_aggregation_default() (persuasion.on_exhausted, promise_rules.on_failure.outcome, unique first_note_not_equal table row with reason in notes.reasons) -> gap 'closing.aggregation.default: no safe default derivable' (or old 'no outcome for a verified call...' when there is no aggregation) + degraded; derived => warn 'closing.aggregation.default derived: ...'; derived default/precedence embedded via _Build.aggregation_cfg() into final_cfg()['aggregation'] (only when closing.aggregation exists); derive_precedence() fills empty precedence. Derivation of on_exhausted/on_failure also applies when there is no aggregation (old behaviour kept, warning reworded). pipeline: _degrade_compile(ctx, report) called in stage_compile_workflow and _try_repair (dedupes). tests/fixtures/spec_rehearsal.json is a byte copy (cmp verified). node_prompts: new public helpers business_week_text(spec), holidays_with_weekdays(spec), callback_hours_words(spec); node_prompts now imports builder.engine (WEEKDAYS). _date_lines: business-week sentence + 'Use only dates that appear in the lists...' rule; _third_party_lines: business-week, holidays with weekday names, per-weekday hours (the old 'Business days exclude...' text is gone); DATE_RULE_TEXT business_days_after_today + date_n in _persuasion_lines; _multi_lines per-product numbered loop (only multi-product with notes + both tools). lint: rule_repeat_counts registered last in RULES (warn). For FEAT-004 (compiler.py/node_prompts.py): build() now ends with apply_gap_guard() then finish(); final_cfg() is cached and calls fallback_post() then derive_precedence() before aggregation_cfg(), keep that order; _multi_lines/negotiate_task/_date_lines changed so re-read before editing; _mandated/_say_goodbye call sites untouched. Tests added: tests/test_gap_guard.py (9), test_pipeline_compile +1, test_node_prompts +4, test_lint +2.
